name: Swamplight Manor
summary: In Witch Hill, 'Swamp Eye' Jarl cooks strange fare at Swamplight Manor. The crooked shack is his home, and his unusual tastes are known across the mire. Its garden draws the attention of Theramore and Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: A Hermit's Respite in the Mire
sections.body:
In Witch Hill, a crooked wooden shack shelters the recluse 'Swamp Eye' Jarl. Fog, muck, and restless marsh ghosts surround his home, far from any lordly estate. Jarl lives alone and spends his days making strange local dishes from marsh creatures.

Travelers come for his eccentric cooking or shelter from the spirits. Jarl also recruits them to hunt unusual ingredients, including marsh frog legs and creature eyes.

sections.title: Secrets in the Garden
sections.body:
Travelers seek Jarl's cooking or shelter from Witch Hill's spirits. In his makeshift garden, a loose pile of dirt covers a discarded orcish spy's report, with a severed head nearby.

Theramore's guards under Captain Garran Vimes and Horde forces at Brackenwall Village both seek the documents. The hermit's overgrown patch has become a point of tension between them.

faq.q: Why is a tiny shack called a 'Manor'?
faq.answer: The name is ironic: Swamplight Manor is a soggy, rundown wooden shack. Its reclusive inhabitant, 'Swamp Eye' Jarl, gave it the grand name against Witch Hill's dreary gloom.
'Swamp Eye' Jarl lives alone at Swamplight Manor. The half-crazed hermit cooks strange local dishes and hires passing travelers to find peculiar ingredients and help with the local spirits.

faq.q: What is buried in the garden outside?
faq.answer: A discarded spy report penned by an orc lies beneath disturbed earth in Jarl's yard, with a severed head nearby. Theramore's Alliance authorities and Horde scouts from Brackenwall Village both seek the intelligence.

faq.q: Can both Alliance and Horde players visit Jarl?
aliases: can horde talk to swamp eye jarl
faq.answer: Yes. Jarl lives far from civilization and keeps neutral. He accepts help and trades recipes with Alliance and Horde travelers alike.

angles.text: For cooks who brave the marsh, Jarl is an eccentric master of swamp foraging. He makes regional meals from creatures most chefs would dread to touch.
Theramore scouts sent by Captain Garran Vimes watch rumors around the manor, especially reports of missing scouts and intercepted Horde correspondence.
